title: The route changes. Someone still needs an answer.

slides.headline: The route just changed.
slides.body: For the person waiting at the next handover, the next update matters.

slides.headline: So did the coverage.
slides.body: A detour can take a tracker beyond the cellular conditions it was designed around.

slides.headline: Which update cannot wait?
slides.body: Rank the location, delay and exception messages that change a human decision.

slides.headline: Give the exception a plan.
slides.body: Design cellular retries, a satellite message path and what happens when neither is available.

slides.headline: Bring us the real route.
slides.body: Start with one journey, its critical messages and your device constraints.

technicalNotes.headline: Where does the route exceed your network assumption?
technicalNotes.body: Detours, depots and remote handover points can expose a coverage dependency.

technicalNotes.headline: Rank the events
technicalNotes.body: Routine location updates, exceptions, tamper events and safety alerts do not carry equal urgency.

technicalNotes.headline: Define the behaviour
technicalNotes.body: Set cellular retry, satellite escalation, payload size, acknowledgement and store-and-forward rules.

technicalNotes.headline: Design the whole device
technicalNotes.body: Power, antennas, enclosure, firmware, service costs and operations must be reviewed together.

technicalNotes.headline: Assess the coverage gap
technicalNotes.body: Bring a real route and message profile to a scoped Hybrid IoT design conversation.
